acceptance.result: Shared SQLite source/generation/job/chunk state and lazy FTS5 publication use atomic generation CAS. Pending/failed builds are not active; 1100-chunk batch publication and FTS-failure rollback are covered. A locator-only source change advances intent and retires the prior generation even when the full-file version and digest stay fixed.

Creates, edits, ACL changes, revocation/deletion, source changes during stop and restart reconcile through the same owner. Invalidation removes eligibility and fences late publication; query quotes require current owner pin/ACL checks.

Startup reconciliation, WatcherHub hints and periodic scans share one intent owner. Durable leases, nonces, total deadlines, three attempts, idempotency and derived cleanup are exercised; an abruptly exited child leaves a recoverable lease and cannot publish after recovery.

FTS initialization is outside shared startup DDL. Lost/recreated/invalid FTS remains unavailable until rebuild; real Electron restarts with malformed FTS and retains ordinary Chat UI. Chunking, publication and old-generation cleanup execute in native workers.

Planned store, recovery and Electron files are implemented and requiredTests. The clean final candidate passes all 18 gates, root 111/111, runtime 24/24, Electron 1/1, complete types and 12 Harness CI stages.
